# Zameel

> Zameel (زميل, zameel.cx) is an outsourcing company that runs Arabic and English customer support and back-office work for companies in the Gulf region. A dedicated Zameel team works inside the client's own tools and hours, with an account manager, written quality standards and a weekly report.

Zameel works with businesses that need bilingual (Arabic and English) support over WhatsApp, Instagram, live chat, email and phone, plus checklist-driven back-office work. Pilots are available. Contact: info@zameel.cx.

## Services

- [Arabic & English customer support outsourcing](https://zameel.cx/services/customer-support-outsourcing/): chat, email and voice support by a dedicated team, in the client's tools and hours.
- [WhatsApp customer support outsourcing](https://zameel.cx/services/whatsapp-support/): WhatsApp, Instagram and live chat answered in Arabic and English.
- [Back-office outsourcing](https://zameel.cx/services/back-office/): order and refund processing, data entry, document handling and seller onboarding.
- [Ramadan and peak-season support cover](https://zameel.cx/services/peak-season-support/): extra trained agents for Ramadan, White Friday and back-to-school.

## Arabic

- [الصفحة الرئيسية بالعربية](https://zameel.cx/ar/): زميل، دعم العملاء والأعمال المكتبية بالعربية والإنجليزية.
